structural_development.rationale: The post-response is a single full sentence, but it introduces multiple new conceptual dimensions (sleep in addition to wake-up, affordability, accessibility, refreshed, productive, natural rhythms) that were entirely absent from the pre-response. The vision expands from a single product feature description to a multi-clause mission statement covering outcome, access, and physiological alignment.

semantic_events.post_evidence: make better sleep and wake-up experiences affordable and accessible
semantic_events.rationale: Subsumption test: a clock is a specific way of delivering a sleep and wake-up experience (TRUE). PRE is a concrete product instance; POST lifts the scope to the broader experience category the product serves. This is not pure expansion because the product concept is reorganized around its experiential purpose rather than merely broadened in scope.

semantic_events.post_evidence: make better sleep and wake-up experiences affordable and accessible
semantic_events.rationale: The pre-frame is a feature-centric / engineering specification view of the brand; the post-frame is a purpose-centric / mission-and-access positioning view. The sunlight feature is not contradicted but reconceived as one means within a broader accessibility-oriented vision. Same subject (the brand's role in sleep/wake), different organizing frame.

semantic_events.post_evidence: helping people feel more refreshed, productive, and in sync with their natural rhythms
semantic_events.rationale: The pre-version specifies one functional outcome (ease of waking). The post-version retains that seed and broadens it to multiple outcomes (refreshed, productive, aligned with natural rhythms) plus extends the temporal scope to the full sleep–wake cycle. The pre idea is preserved and grew in scope.

uncertainty.coder_notes: The clock→experiences pair sits between Narrowed (clock as a specific instance of sleep/wake experience) and Expanded (broadening from product to category). I selected Narrowed because subsumption holds, but Expanded is a defensible alternative. The sunlight-feature pair could plausibly be read as Elaborated (feature retained within a larger mission) rather than Reframed; I selected Reframed because the organizing frame shifts from feature-spec to mission/access positioning. The wake-up outcome pair is the cleanest Expanded of the three.
